caveats: Google Search and Google Maps returned a CAPTCHA / 'unusual traffic' wall from this network for every query, so I could not read Google Business Profile claim status, Google star ratings or Google review counts. Ratings and review counts cited here come from Birdeye aggregated business profiles, which often mirror Google data but were not confirmed against Google directly.

Cross-source NAP disagreements exist for several businesses (e.g. R Caruso: site phone (732) 246-2407 vs batch phone (732) 846-4346, and 982 Clark Rd vs 1441 Joseph St). Batch data was treated as unverified.

BuildZoom, Manta, HomeAdvisor, YellowPages, whereorg and allpages returned HTTP 403 or Cloudflare bot checks on direct fetch; their content is cited only where a search result surfaced a specific figure, and none of their licence/project counts were independently opened and verified except where noted.

New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs licence lookup (newjersey.mylicense.com) was used as the primary 'is it trading' evidence. 'Expired' or 'Inactive' on an Electrical Business Permit means the business permit is not current; some contractors keep working informally, so status was recorded as 'not found' rather than 'closed' unless records explicitly said Closed.

Eight of ten businesses in this batch have no website. For those, the website review and agent-readiness fields reflect absence of a site rather than a broken one, and no mobile rendering could be inspected.
data_gaps: Google Business Profile data (claimed status, categories, photos, ratings) for all 10 businesses: blocked by Google CAPTCHA from this network.
A B Wolfe Electric: no NJ electrical business permit matched 'WOLFE' in the electrical profession; licence may sit under an individual's name or a differently named entity - unverified.

Three Phase Electric Inc.: a 'THREE PHASE ELECTRIC INC' permit (34EB00901700) is Active in Freehold, NJ; could not determine whether that is the same company as the North Brunswick Route 130 listing, so no licence conclusion was drawn.
Interior Wiring Services LLC and Ampro Electrical Contractors: no permit match found under the listed trade name; ownership and current trading status unverified.
R Caruso & Sons and Cioffi Electric: no accessibility, performance or Core Web Vitals testing was done (out of scope for triage); only layout, content, DOM/schema and robots.txt checks.
No on-site review text was quoted for any business; review sentiment beyond rating and count was not read in depth.
